name: q3-cpu-expansion-v2
hardware: CPU only for sampling, optimization, inference and evaluation
method: PPO v3/base/MLP96/flat, gamma=1, GAE lambda=0.95; no behavior-cloning loss
future_test_access: Not opened by the handoff runner; freeze model selection before later evaluation
budget: Three trials, at most 60 minutes each by default; checkpoints every 10 minutes; complete or partial progress reported literally
comparison: Report all three seeds and endpoints, initialization baseline and state-search baseline; no best-seed-only claim
failure_policy: Keep failures; incomplete episodes receive 360000 virtual seconds penalty; failed-clear actions retain actual charged costs; no promotion if failed clearance or missing completion

official_observation_database.allowed_use: Validation and trajectory auditing only, regardless of legacy trainable/split fields
official_observation_database.forbidden_use: Training, imitation targets, normalization fitting, scenario distribution fitting, or replacing hidden truth with source estimates
official_observation_database.limitation: Logged trajectories lack the hidden world needed for new-action counterfactual simulation; do not claim new-policy full clearance times from replay

official_access: No official HTTP client or official simulator access in this package
